description: A valkey ACL user, with its password, permissions and key access.

name.description: Name of the user. Can not start with `_`.

enabled.description: Whether the user can authenticate. Users are enabled when unset.

name.description: Name of the Secret with the passwords. Defaults to the users Secret of the cluster.

keys.description: Keys of the Secret with the passwords, several keys allow rotation. Defaults to the name of the user.

passwordSecret.description: Secret with the passwords of the user.

nopass.description: Whether the user can authenticate without a password.

resetpass.description: Whether the ACL rules of the user are reset before the other settings are applied.

allow.description: Commands, or categories (`@category`), the user can run.

deny.description: Commands, or categories (`@category`), the user can not run.

commands.description: Commands the user can and can not run.

readWrite.description: Key patterns the user can read and write.

readOnly.description: Key patterns the user can only read.

writeOnly.description: Key patterns the user can only write.

keys.description: Key patterns the user can access.

patterns.description: Pub/sub channel patterns the user can access.

channels.description: Pub/sub channels the user can access.

permissions.description: Raw ACL string appended after the generated rules, for example `+@all ~* &*`.
